marker_review.ordered_footer: sequence0..11, marker names, original JSON payload byte counts+SHA256 and ordered list SHA256

packaging_review.presence_is_not_semantic_validation: Packager verifies existence/byte hashes, not validity of every JUnit/log/JSON body. Synthetic complete fixtures do not prove native success.

budget_cleanup_guard_review.anchor: First runner step local clock, explicitly not actual job start

budget_cleanup_guard_review.cleanup: Owned UID/PID/start-time/group checks, KVM node identity and exact ACL restoration, both trap+always required
budget_cleanup_guard_review.minimal_kvm_grant: only caller UID rw with --no-mask when necessary

remaining_activation_gates: Root binds a real unique prep-parent SHA in the branch-specific workflow guard; the reviewed proposal intentionally still contains the zero guard.
Root supplies and verifies EXECUTION_SHA256SUMS and the exact active workflow/source/control commit before its single attempt1 activation. No active/run/job identity is fabricated here.
limits: No network, CI, Gradle, new APK build, ADB, emulator, privilege mutation, production edit, probe edit or workflow activation was performed by this review.
Pure-parser checks use an old valid raw library log solely as a schema fixture; no old/new performance sample pooling.

Forwarding footer completion is per-method only. Consumers must also require every required method and install group, final status, cleanup, missing_files empty, packaging complete and matching source/plan hashes.
Log-derived screening does not establish original ZIP/APK bytes. The real run still needs original artifact verification and native result analysis.
The hard60-minute job timeout can interrupt tail steps; a missing cleanup/artifact receipt remains unconfirmed, never assumed success.
Screening18 methods does not close unrelated full20k rapid-input gate or formal acceptance.
